whoWeAre.title: Biblio Squad, academic excellence in Sfax
whoWeAre.body: Biblio Squad is the first academic institution of excellence in Sfax, accredited by leading international bodies, ensuring high-standard training programs aligned with global benchmarks. Our programs cover engineering, architecture, IT, digital marketing, graphic design, and languages. As an official training and examination center, Biblio Squad awards internationally recognized certifications.

whyBiblioSquad.title: Comprehensive training, dual certification
whyBiblioSquad.body: Biblio Squad distinguishes itself through a comprehensive training offer spanning engineering, architecture, IT, digital marketing, graphic design, project management, entrepreneurship, soft skills, and languages. Graduates receive a dual certification: an official Tunisian certificate and an internationally accredited credential.

ourVision.title: Developing tomorrow's talent
ourVision.body: Establish Biblio Squad as the national reference in professional training and certification, developing highly qualified talents capable of excelling globally.
